its growth momentum with advances growing by 21% Y-o-Y and deposits growing by 19%. In 
keeping with the guidance, both advances and deposits have doubled over September 2022 over 
the last 4 years. 
 
Our net interest income grew by 17% Y-o-Y. Over the last one year, the yield on advances 
dropped by 38 basis points, while during the same period, we reduced the cost of funds by 34 
basis points. If you look at the last quarter, our yield on advances dropped by 2 basis points, 
while cost of funds dropped by 8 basis points. 
 
If you look at revenue, it grew by 21% Y-o-Y. Core fee income continuing to be strong. And 
also the focus we have on our productivity and on technology adoption is helping us in keeping 
our cost to average assets under control. It continues to be below 2.5%, just to be precise at 
2.47%.. And our cost to income is at 59.64% at an 18-quarter low. 
During the last 2 years, we have grown our employee strength by 1%, our balance sheet by 34% 
and our revenue by 33%. The fact that the revenue grew by 21% and cost grew by 18% Y-o-Y 
meant that operating profit grew by 26% Y-o-Y. 
 
The portfolio quality continues to improve with our credit cost at 0.28%. Our GNPA is at 2.29% 
and NNPA is at 0.73%, both of which are at a 23-quarter low. Our PCR is at 81.38%, a 7.23% 
improvement over the last year and PCR, excluding technical write-off is at 68.75%, a 9.6% 
improvement over the last year. As a consequence of all this, our net profit has risen by 29% 
over the year to INR 236 crores, which is the highest ever in a quarter. 
 
This is the fifth consecutive quarter where the bank is clocking a highest ever quarterly net profit. 
As a result, our ROA is at 1.03% for the quarter and 1% for the half year. Also, the ROE is 
14.6% for the quarter and 14.12% for the half year.

window. So this really increased the liquidity significantly, and that has a liquidity cost attached 
to it.
